input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for ids, position. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Customer, I want to interact with activity functionality, so that I can accomplish my activity-related tasks.
